criteria.text: public/styles/tokens.css defines every token of tokens.json as a custom property of the same name (--<name>): the light values in :root and the dark values under @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark), sizes in px and durations in ms, with the approved values.
Every text/background pair of tokens.json is documented in the comment block of tokens.css (one "--text on --background" per line) and reaches 4.5:1 in the light and the dark theme.
Outside tokens.css no stylesheet, inline style or script uses a colour, font size, spacing, radius or duration literal: each is var(--…) of a token, and the 3D materials read the --scene-* tokens.
At 360 px: one column, the tab bar spans the width under the logo and name, fields one per row, and nothing is wider than the viewport (no horizontal scroll).
At 720 px and wider: two columns, 2fr/3fr — set-up and prediction on the left; the 3D scene with playback, Compare and the explanation on the right; the tabs sit at the right of the header row.
At 1280 px: two columns 5fr/7fr, content capped at --size-content-max (1200 px) and centred, stepper captions shown.
Every input of the three labs has a visible <label> naming its unit in parentheses — kg, m/s, m, degrees, 1/m, or (dimensionless) for μ — and each slider is labelled by the same label.
Every focusable element keeps a visible :focus-visible ring: outline --size-focus-ring solid --color-focus, offset --size-focus-offset; no rule removes it.
Transitions last --duration-fast to --duration-slow (150–250 ms); under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce every transition and animation is removed and the 3D run does not autoplay (it waits for Play).

Each lab panel carries data-state (predict, run, compare, input-error, scene-unavailable, startup-error, and the lab's special case no-collision or never-stops); the stepper carries data-stepper with aria-current="step" on the current step; a missing token sets data-tokens="missing".
The header mark is the effective logo compact variant, copied byte for byte.
The start-up failure card shows the effective logo on_light variant in the light theme, copied byte for byte.
The start-up failure card shows the effective logo on_dark variant in the dark theme, copied byte for byte.
The page's icon (<link rel="icon">) is the effective favicon default variant, copied byte for byte.

After each run the explanation card names the law, shows the equation with the player's own numbers substituted line by line ending in the result, and says in a sentence or two why it came out this way (including the no-collision and never-stops cases).

Each run animates in 3D following the simulated positions: carts collide and separate (or stick), the block slides and stops at the simulated distance (or slides off), the ball flies its arc leaving a trail and lands at the simulated range; play, pause and replay work.

The look and feel matches the approved mockups in both themes: confident and uncluttered; the stepper reads predict → run → compare; the scene has soft shadows, a subtle grid, the whole run in view and colours that match the page; the score is a large number with a coloured bar.

human_tests.text: Play each lab in a browser at 360, 720 and 1280 px in the light and the dark theme: switch labs with the tabs and with the keyboard (←/→), use Back and Forward between labs, run a prediction with the keyboard alone (Tab to the fields, Enter to run, Play/Pause/Replay), and check the focus ring is always visible. Turn on reduced motion and confirm nothing animates until Play.
